horizon_driver: no formal exit option under capital controls forces a long effective horizon (aligned with ST_CN's 10-year horizon), but the proximate savings-rate behavior is a much shorter (1-2yr) precautionary response to property and employment uncertainty

constraints.action: large-scale outbound capital transfer beyond the ~$50k/year individual quota
constraints.breaks_under: near-total loss of confidence in RMB-denominated savings; not observed even through the 2021-26 property downturn

constraints.action: organised public protest over frozen pre-sale housing / developer defaults
constraints.source: observed but suppressed 2022 mortgage-boycott episodes across multiple cities
constraints.breaks_under: a large regional cluster of simultaneous developer defaults with no visible state backstop

stated_vs_revealed.stated: The 2025 Government Work Report made consumption stimulus the top policy priority, with trade-in subsidies, consumption vouchers, and a fiscal impulse estimated at ~1.6% of GDP.
stated_vs_revealed.revealed: Household bank deposits have nearly doubled over five years and China's household consumption share of GDP remains under 40% (total consumption ~56.6% of GDP) versus a 60-80% developed-market norm, even though the stimulus produced a real but shallow retail-sales bounce (+5.0% YoY Jan-May 2025, +6.4% in May alone).
stated_vs_revealed.delta: Stimulus moves the needle at the margin but does not produce the structural consumption rebalancing officially targeted; households are revealed to be saving through the stimulus rather than because of an absence of one.

stated_vs_revealed.stated: Official framing treats the property-market correction as a managed, bottoming-out adjustment.
stated_vs_revealed.revealed: New home sales fell 9.2% YoY in 2025 (residential sales value down 13.0% to RMB7.33tn); Fitch forecasts a further 11-13% decline in 2026, and prices continued falling through H1 2026 as buyers held back waiting for a floor.
stated_vs_revealed.delta: Households are revealed to be deliberately deferring purchases in anticipation of further declines rather than responding to 'bottoming' messaging, which itself reinforces the deflationary spiral.

tripwires.if: new-home price declines continue for 2+ more years without a credible developer-liability backstop
tripwires.then: the precautionary savings rate stays structurally elevated and consumption-stimulus multipliers keep shrinking regardless of voucher size

tripwires.if: a cluster of simultaneous large regional developer defaults leaves pre-sale buyers without homes or refunds
tripwires.then: localized mortgage-boycott-style collective action re-emerges (2022 precedent), pressuring ST_CN for an explicit, visible backstop

what_would_change_my_mind: A sustained (3+ quarter) rise in the household consumption share of GDP alongside falling deposit growth would indicate the precautionary-savings equilibrium is genuinely breaking, not just being temporarily subsidized.
